facts.text: Gina has a tattoo that represents freedom and the idea of dancing without worrying about others' opinions.

evidence.quote: Got the tattoo a few years ago, it stands for freedom - dancing without worrying what people think.
Even made a tattoo to remind myself about it.

facts.text: Jon agrees with Gina's perspective on freedom and self-expression through dance, and mentions that dance provides him with an escape to be himself.

evidence.quote: It's so important to have freedom and express ourselves without worry. Dance gives me an escape to be myself.

facts.text: Jon is dedicated to his dance studio and is committed to pursuing his dreams in dance, which he considers his passion.

evidence.quote: You're so dedicated to your studio, it's inspiring. Chase those dreams, buddy!
I'm gonna keep chasing after those dreams. Dance is my passion, and I'm gonna keep working hard to make it a success!

facts.text: Jon mentions that he balances his passion for dance with his business goals, and that the two provide energy and motivation for each other.

evidence.quote: Dancing and running my biz need hard work, plus they give me energy for each other. My dance moves get me pumped to tackle my business goals, and successes there boost my drive to keep dreaming on the dance floor.
